CLIP (with atom IDs): E02.029 | 01:05.00-01:10.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Mara toward Selene.
E02.030 | 01:05.20-01:10.00 | ACT | Selene grabs Mara by the wrist.
E02.031 | 01:05.40-01:08.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (furious, venomous) | "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
E02.032 | 01:10.00-01:16.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E02.033 | 01:10.40-01:13.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (silken, venomous) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E02.034 | 01:16.00-01:20.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E02.035 | 01:16.40-01:19.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (O.S., afraid, gruff) | "They are coming up the cliff path with lanterns!"
E02.036 | 01:20.00-01:26.00 | CAM | Close-up on Selene's jaw tightening.
E02.037 | 01:20.40-01:23.06 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (cold, triumphant) | "The council has already decided her fate."
E02.038 | 01:26.00-01:31.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.
E02.039 | 01:26.20-01:31.00 | ACT | the widow kneels on the slick quay boards.
E02.040 | 01:26.40-01:27.92 | DLG | CORIN (dry, earnest) | "Step away from her."
E02.041 | 01:31.00-01:35.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E02.042 | 01:31.20-01:35.00 | ACT | Corin tears the lace veil and lets it fall.
E02.043 | 01:31.40-01:34.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (triumphant, pompous) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
